messages.author: d064bff96e6d59d8
messages.subject: Re: Error in .Call2("solve_user_SEW0", start, end, width, PACKAGE = "IRanges")
parts:
Hello,
I would add a comment for another issue giving the error "Error in .Call2("solve_user_SEW0", start, end, width, PACKAGE = "IRanges")".
It can also happen when you try to convert a methylKit DB object into a methylKit object (saved in the RAM) and then try to subset the object with the function "regionCounts"  using a bed file. Although no error is diplayed when putting the methylKit object in the RAM, the error will happen afterwards when doing the subsetting. This is because the object in RAM is incomplete with many lines containing NAs (try checking the end of your R object with tail()). This causes a bug with the IRanges overlapping tool. The solution is to provide more RAM to the code execution. I solved the bug when running in local instead of using the server but did not understand at first why it was not working in one case.
